projection_source_rule: Week 1 uses Sleeper, week 2 onward uses our model. On 2025 week 1, ranking actual DK points, Sleeper beat us at every position (rho 0.786 vs 0.729 overall, RB 0.834 vs 0.697) and had the better MAE. Our week-1 windows hold only last season's final four games.
method: Per-position affine calibration onto DK Classic points, fitted on 2025. Absorbs full PPR, yardage bonuses, and the median-to-mean gap in one step. Not the trained direct-DK model.
ceiling_note: ceiling_pts is an 85th-percentile OUTCOME, not a prediction. Residuals are right skewed: median residual is negative at every position while the mean is zero. Correct objective for a tournament, wrong one for cash. Models neither correlation nor ownership.
limits: QB fit R2 is low (~0.09-0.10). Residual sd 4.9 to 7.9 DK points. Fitted on 2025 only.
